
---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r data-preparation, include=FALSE}
data("ny_noaa")

weather =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2000-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2010-12-31")
  )

selected_station =
  weather |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarize(
    n_complete = sum(!is.na(tmax) & !is.na(prcp)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(n_complete, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(id)

weather =
  weather |>
  filter(id == selected_station) |>
  mutate(
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    prcp_mm = as.numeric(prcp) / 10,
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    month_name = month.abb[month],
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")
    )
  )

monthly_temp =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_temp = mean(tmax_c),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(
      month.abb[month],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  )

monthly_prcp =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(prcp_mm)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_prcp = mean(prcp_mm),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(
      month.abb[month],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  )

seasonal_temp =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax_c))
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Average Maximum Temperature

```{r temperature-line}
monthly_temp |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_name,
    y = ~avg_temp,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    line = list(color = "#2878B5", width = 3),
    marker = list(size = 8),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "%{x}",
      "<br>Average max temp: %{y:.1f} °C",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)"),
    margin = list(b = 65, l = 65)
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Average Daily Precipitation by Month

```{r precipitation-bar}
monthly_prcp |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_name,
    y = ~avg_prcp,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = "#46A6A0"),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "%{x}",
      "<br>Average daily precipitation: %{y:.2f} mm",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Precipitation (mm)"),
    margin = list(b = 55, l = 65)
  )
```

### Daily Maximum Temperature by Season

```{r temperature-box}
seasonal_temp |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~season,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "box",
    color = ~season,
    colors = c(
      "#4575B4",
      "#66A182",
      "#E9A23B",
      "#C86B65"
    ),
    boxpoints = FALSE,
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "%{x}",
      "<br>Temperature: %{y:.1f} °C",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Season"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"),
    margin = list(b = 55, l = 65)
  )
```
